metadata.scope: Complete Admin navigation; sampled nested states; design-only comparison
metadata.verdict: Not an exact match; not ready for UI-parity sign-off
metadata.source: Current-run browser captures; original JPEG bytes preserved
metadata.viewport: Matched within pairs at 746×1120 or 1112×1120 CSS pixels. Browser screenshot output sometimes proportionally rescales around scrollbars. Different modules used different widths. Some scrolled states have different vertical offsets.
metadata.routeMetadata: URLs identify module landing routes, not guaranteed deep-state URLs. Per-capture DOM and original viewport records were not retained; encoded image dimensions and hashes are verified directly from saved files.
metadata.privacy: Contains tenant-visible names, contact details and account information; share only with authorized reviewers. SMTP credential fields in the distributed capture contain unsaved redaction text; nothing was saved to the source portal.
